notes.title: Patch Notes 12th June 2018
notes.notes:
We just uploaded a patch to fix issues found in the text of the game. We are aware some of these changes may affect earlier efforts by players, and can only apologise for that. The fixes are as follows:

Cycle 27. Bergen. The signal's faint, but I'd know that voice anywhere: my boy. [&!|#P29_L2_W7&!|#]
I'm not going crazy.

Now reads:

Cycle 27. Bergen. The signal's faint, but I'd know that voice anywhere: my boy. [&!|#P29_L3_W7&!|#]
I'm not going crazy.


The screen in the kitchen showed the final volunteer waver

Now reads:

The screen in the kitchen showed the final volunteer waiver


‘Single-Seat HB?

Now reads:

‘Single-Seat HB?’

notes.title: Patch Notes 8th June 2018
notes.notes:
I just uploaded a patch which is pulling in some small improvements from the switch port we are currently working on.


    Changed compression of music files to improve quality
    Updated to Unity 2017.4.3
    Loading screen percentage now rounds
    [spoiler]Redacted[/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch Notes 3rd May 2018
notes.notes:
I just pushed out a patch with some general performance improvements. It started out that I wasn't happy with the load time between runs, and turned into a week of tweaking!


    Load time into a game is reduced, meaning it's even harder to stop playing!
    Drones which don't encounter the player after 30 seconds are removed
    General performance improvements to the drone AI
    General performance improvements to particle system


Let us know what you think!

There are just a few days left to vote for Cycle 28 in the GDWC fan favourite competition. If you enjoy Cycle 28 please consider voting.

notes.title: Monthly Leaderboard Patch
notes.notes:

We have just added monthly leaderboards to the game. Restart Steam to force the update. Looking forward to seeing even more competition over high scores, who is consistant enough to stay on the top each month, and who just got lucky?

notes.title: A Month After Release and Still No Solution
notes.notes:
Yesterday marked one month from the release of Cycle 28. In so many ways we've been blown away by the response from players, reviewers, and the growing Cycle 28 community. 

But one of the most exciting things for us as devs has been watching the monumental effort put into the puzzle of Cycle 28 by a number of players. It's been fantastic to watch the collective efforts, info sharing, theories, etc, in our discord channel and here on Steam. 

So much work done, but still so much to do it would seem. We still haven't had a solution to the mystery of Cycle 28, so we haven't been able to award the Pill Bug Golden Ticket. 

It's only been a month, so we haven't given up hope - and neither has the community...

Good hunting, Lieutenant!

notes.title: Patch Notes 12th March
notes.notes:
We just pushed out a tiny update with two tweaks:


    Fixed a weird bug with the text rendering (if you watched Stealelves stream you would have seen it)
    Slightly reduced the debris effect. Watching high level play since launch we have seen that it can get a bit much. Reducing might also help with performance on integrated graphics cards.

notes.title: Release Day! Reviews and Let's Plays inside...
notes.notes:
It's finally here folks, launch day! We hope you enjoy the game, please let us know what you think... We are going to be editing this post throughout the day adding reviews and lets plays as we find them. 

Reviews

Gamers with Jobs
...you decide to play one more round, and somehow you end up playing for twenty minutes on the best run of your life. You’re afraid to quit because you’ve never been on such a roll, but if you don’t quit you’ll be late for work. And somehow you’re still playing.

The Welsh Gaming Network
Cycle 28 is a fast-paced modern take on a classic 2D space shooter that is simple in design and offers great replayability. The skill ceiling is only as high as you want to make it and the action that unfolds on screen is accompanied by a great soundtrack.

If you’re looking for a game that is well worth the measly asking price of £3.99 then look no further, it’s a great game to pick up and have a blast on and will only take up as much time as you want to put into it.

notes.title: Dev Update - Cycle 28 is finished!
notes.notes:
It's a weird weekend. 

Firstly it's weird because we didn't post a Cycle 28 game play video. Instead we started a series called "More Like This" where we play games which Steam suggest are "Like Cycle 28". We start by playing 64.0, which is currently on sale. I liked it quite a lot and you can watch me playing it below.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jFdAes3HbzI

It's also weird because for the first time in in a long time I don't have any coding to do because Cycle 28 is finished. Now our beta testers are hard at work starting to break it and Dave and I are hard at work trying to promote it. 

We also bought cameras this week and the first thing I did was share my thoughts about what it's like releasing an indie game in 2018. You can watch those below.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hcMOMcTIfnw

As always, we like to hear from you so follow us on Twitter (@pillbugint), or Facebook https://www.facebook.com/PillBugInt/ , or chat on Discord: https://discord.gg/yGfqpVu
